1 Hour of Peaceful Ocean Harp Music | Sarah Bhalla
lista.descripcion: Just as I arrived at the shore, the sun broke through the clouds, casting a warm golden glow. The waves crashed in rhythm, and the gentle breeze danced through the harp strings. In that incredible moment, I felt deeply grateful for these pure, beautiful gifts of nature. I’m so thankful to share this experience, a serene blend of music and the natural world. All of the music is improvised around a few compositional ideas, played intuitively, flowing with the rhythm of this peaceful space.
